::: {#exm-prediction-cond-mean}
#### Predicting with an estimated conditional mean

Suppose a model specifies the conditional mean $\E{Y \mid X = x}$
as a function $\mean(x; \vth)$ of a parameter vector $\vth$,
and $\est{\vth}$ is an estimate of $\vth$.
The usual prediction (@def-prediction) of $Y$ at $X = x$
is the estimated conditional mean:

$$\fitted(x) = \mean(x; \est{\vth}).$$
:::
